_note: Calendar-day reset rules and anti-overfeeding behavior.

meal_rule.target: One meaningful full meal per day is normally enough to fund all eight daily actions.
meal_rule.anti_midnight_overfeed: Crossing midnight does not empty the pet's stomach or force food/energy to zero. Remaining food/energy carries over.
meal_rule.extra_feed_behavior: If the pet is still sufficiently full, an additional feed gives only a reaction and does not stack energy, duplicate meal growth, or exceed 100.

treat_rule.growth: Each accepted treat can roll weighted random developmental stat micro-growth.
treat_rule.after_limit: Further treats are refused with a pet reaction until the next calendar-day reset.
